title: CertificateOfInsurance
description: Fields copied from a certificate of insurance. Do not add an expiry status or a reminder decision.

policy_number.description: Policy or certificate number, exactly as printed.

insurer.description: Insurance company that issued the certificate.

coverage_types.description: Coverage names, such as General Liability.

limits.description: Limit printed for each coverage. Keep the amount as text.

effective_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or null if it is not printed.

expiry_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, or null if it is not printed. Do not decide whether it is expired.

confidence.description: Certainty from 0 to 1 that the fields match the document.

needs_review.description: True when a required field is missing, a date is ambiguous, or the text looks incomplete.
